91: Accumulated scrambling per second when firing reverse thrusters.
92: Accumulated leaking fuel per second when firing reverse thrusters.
93: Accumulated exothermic interactions per second when firing reverse thrusters.
94: Accumulated engine interference per second when firing reverse thrusters.
95: Accumulated shield interference per second when firing reverse thrusters.
96: Ability to evade detection when a ship is carrying illegal outfits or cargo. Interference of 1 blocks 50% of scan attempts; 3 blocks 75%, and 9 blocks 90%.
97: Allows you to jump without coming to a stop, as long as your velocity is within this range of being lined up with the direction you are jumping in.
98: The chance of this ship self-destructing when you try to board or capture it.
99: What this outfit will sell for, in credits. Outfits and ships will depreciate (lose resale value) over time, and plunder always starts out fully depreciated.
100: Energy consumed per second when recharging shields.
101: Additional energy consumed per second when recharging shields after the shield delay period.
102: Modifies the energy consumed when recharging shields by the given factor.
103: Fuel consumed per second when recharging shields.
104: Additional fuel consumed per second when recharging shields after the shield delay period.
105: Modifies the fuel consumed when recharging shields by the given factor.
106: Heat produced per second when recharging shields.
107: Additional heat produced per second when recharging shields after the shield delay period.
108: Modifies the heat produced when recharging shields by the given factor.
109: Shield points recharged per second. Recharging shields usually consumes energy, and may also produce heat.
110: Additional shield points recharged per second after the shield delay period.
111: Modifies the amount of shield points recharged per second by the given factor.
112: Modifies the amount of shield points recharged per second by the given factor while a cloaking device is active.
113: This percentage of all incoming damage bypasses shields and applies directly to the hull when at full shields.
114: This percentage of all incoming damage will bypass shields and apply directly to the hull as shields approach zero.
115: This percentage of all incoming damage will bypass shields and apply directly to the hull while you are cloaked.
116: Total shield strength and regeneration rate per second.
117: Total shield strength. Most weapons cannot damage your hull until your shields are depleted. Some weapon effects, such as heat damage, become more severe once shields are down.
118: Modifies the ship's total shield strength by the given factor.
119: The number of seconds it takes for additional shield generation to begin after taking shield damage.
120: The number of seconds it takes for additional shield generation to begin after your shields have been depleted.
